name: Restaurant-Management-System
description: A full restaurant system — floor, orders, kitchen, payments, reservations & online ordering — rebuilt as an app on NimbusCMS. Live demo at ras.nimbuscms.dev; the original 2014 PHP app is preserved in /archive.

paragraphs: The Restaurant Management System, rebuilt as an application on NimbusCMS instead of the original 2014 hand-rolled PHP. It runs a full restaurant — floor, orders, kitchen, payments, staff roles, reservations, reports — plus a public site with online ordering, as a Nimbus plugin co-located in this repo (plugin/) composed with the official CRM (guests) and a theme (theme/). Zero Nimbus core change for app logic.
The original 2014 version is preserved in archive/ (and still runnable — see its README). This is the current system.

Beyond the app, this rebuild is the first real validation of Nimbus as a platform: if a whole restaurant can be built on Nimbus without pushing restaurant-specific logic into the CMS core, the platform is proven. It drove two reusable core capabilities — a read-only content capability for plugins (ADR 0029) and fine-grained plugin capabilities (ADR 0030) — with nothing restaurant-shaped added to core. The running ledger is in docs/PLATFORM-VALIDATION.md; the architecture is in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/adr/0001.
